page_title: LIV 1-1 BUR | Liverpool v Burnley 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
90+6' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andy Madley saw the whole situation.
90+3' The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
90+2' Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+1' Although Ashley Barnes (Burnley) is just on the bench, Andy Madley has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Scott Parker has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) replacing Marcus Edwards.
90' Substitution. Florentino makes his way off the pitch and Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) comes on as his replacement.
87' Here is a change. Curtis Jones is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Federico Chiesa (Liverpool).
85' Substitution. Josh Laurent (Burnley) has come on for Lesley Ugochukwu.
83' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
83' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
81' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Hugo Ekitike.
80' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar.
78' The referee allows time for a substitution. Milos Kerkez will be replaced by Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).
78' Substitution. Ryan Gravenberch leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
78' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) replaces Cody Gakpo.
78' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
77' Liverpool take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

76' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) controls a cross on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive. His effort is directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows his brilliant reflexes and makes a decent save.
74' Scott Parker prepares a substitution. Armando Broja is replaced by Lyle Foster (Burnley).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hjalmar Ekdal is coming onto the pitch as Maxime Esteve (Burnley) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Liverpool are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
70' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) causes Martin Dubravka little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
69' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
67' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 21:5.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Marcus Edwards (Burnley) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Florentino, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
64' Lucas Pires (Burnley) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
64' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Burnley.
63' Florentino (Burnley) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
61' Andy Madley interrupts the game. One of the players from Burnley won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
59' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
58' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
56' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
55' The ratio of the ball possession is 71:29.
53' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
51' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
50' Lucas Pires (Burnley) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
49' Close! Marcus Edwards (Burnley) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
48' Lucas Pires (Burnley) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
45+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+2' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Liverpool are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
42' 1 - 0 Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) latches on to a pass and finds himself in a great position inside the box before unleashing a stunning effort into the top left corner.
40' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) for his blatant foul.
39' The Liverpool players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
37' The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
37' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Liverpool win a corner.
36' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Martin Dubravka sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
36' Total attempts – 11:3.
34' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Martin Dubravka has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
32' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
32' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is going to take the penalty!
31' Florentino (Burnley) jumps into a tackle and Andy Madley signals a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Liverpool is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
29' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates.
28' Armando Broja (Burnley) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
26' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post.
26' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) swings in a cross from the corner, but Martin Dubravka reads it well and gathers the ball.

26' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar.
21' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Martin Dubravka easily deals with the threat.
19' Martin Dubravka displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
17' Florentino (Burnley) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar.
16' The ball possession is 74:26.
14' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
12' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
11' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
10' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
8' Liverpool hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
4' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

4' This should have been a goal! Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) sends a killer pass into the box, but Curtis Jones can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Liverpool as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
